pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 7

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 18

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 22

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
